items.title: Slide Hampton — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: So Lionel Hampton probably was influenced by Louis Armstrong in this entertainment area of music.

ctx.x: Do you think that’s because he was straddling an era? He came from an era when it was about showmen, and transitioned into an era where another kind of consciousness came into the music. He goes back to the ’20s. He probably – excluding Louis Armstrong, he had probably one of the longest expanses stylistically and in time, in the music.

That’s true. He did come from an area where entertainment was very important. Louis Armstrong was one of the great examples. Of course a lot of people don’t realize that, along with all of that entertainment, there was a hell of a lot of genius going on. That probably distracted people sometimes from seeing really what he was doing, because he was such a great entertainer. So Lionel Hampton probably was influenced by Louis Armstrong in this entertainment area of music. Louis Armstrong had a big success with this…
And Cab Calloway. That’s a band I didn’t ask you about. Did that figure in your calculus at all?
